source_notes: R039/R040 'OCR-set assignments' are released to centres via OCR's Teach Cambridge portal; the only public copies are school-website rehosts, which are not cited. Stage criteria and lesson content for R039/R040 therefore anchor on the J822 specification's own task descriptions (section 6.4 and unit content), not on the set-assignment PDFs themselves.
Cited R038/01 mark scheme is the January 2024 series (OCR 716319); a newer series may since have been published and was not checked.

Specification re-read 2026-09-22: the live PDF at OCR file 711493 (assessment from 2025) matches the structure, GLH (48/36/36, 120 total), raw marks (70/60/60, 190 total) and UMS (80/60/60, 200 total) carried over from the original build; no optional units exist in this specification, so all three units are built.
